subject: Refund request
body: I was charged twice for my subscription. Could you check the duplicate payment and explain how I can get a refund?

subject: Payment failed
body: My payment failed when I tried to renew my subscription. How can I update my payment method?

subject: Cancel subscription
body: Please explain how I can cancel my current subscription and whether cancellation takes effect immediately.

subject: Invoice copy
body: I need a copy of my latest invoice for accounting. Could you tell me where I can download it?

subject: Unexpected charge
body: I noticed a charge on my account that I do not recognize. Please help me understand what it is.

subject: Cannot log in
body: I cannot log in to the website even though I am using the correct password. What should I try?

subject: Video upload problem
body: I tried uploading a video but it does not appear on my website. Please explain how to troubleshoot this.

subject: Website error
body: My website displays an error when I open the contact page. Can you help me identify the next steps?

subject: Password reset
body: I requested a password reset email but have not received it. How should I proceed?

subject: Images not displaying
body: The images on several pages are missing. Please suggest how I can investigate the issue.

subject: Slow website
body: My website has become very slow over the last two days. What troubleshooting steps should I follow?

subject: Contact form broken
body: Visitors cannot submit the contact form on my website. Please help me resolve this problem.

subject: Mobile layout issue
body: The website layout looks broken on mobile phones but works on my laptop. What could I check?

subject: Browser compatibility
body: A page works in Chrome but fails in Firefox. Can you recommend troubleshooting steps?

subject: Unable to publish page
body: I edited a page but cannot publish the changes. Please explain how I can investigate this.

subject: Poor customer service
body: I have contacted support several times and still have no resolution. I am disappointed with the experience.

subject: Complaint about downtime
body: My website was unavailable during business hours. I would like an explanation of the outage and what is being done.

subject: Unresolved support ticket
body: My support ticket has been open for a week without an update. Could someone review it and tell me the status?

subject: Incorrect account details
body: My account details were changed unexpectedly. Please investigate this and tell me how to secure my account.

subject: Request for manager
body: I would like a manager to review my complaint because the previous response did not address my concern.

subject: New website quotation
body: We need a quotation for a new business website with five pages, a contact form, and a photo gallery.

subject: Website redesign
body: We want to redesign our existing website with a modern layout. Can you explain what information you need to estimate the work?

subject: Add booking functionality
body: Our business wants customers to book appointments online. Please let us know whether this feature can be added and how it would be scoped.

subject: E-commerce project
body: We are planning an online store with product pages and checkout. Please advise what details are needed for a proposal.

subject: Website migration
body: We want to migrate our existing website to a new platform. Can you help us identify the requirements and likely work involved?

subject: Custom dashboard
body: We need a dashboard showing sales and customer activity. Please let us know what information you need before preparing a quotation.

subject: Add a blog
body: We want to add a blog section to our website with categories, article pages, and search.

subject: Third-party integration
body: We would like to connect our website to a third-party CRM. Can you explain the details needed to estimate this integration?

subject: Accessibility improvements
body: We need our website reviewed for accessibility and would like a proposal for the required improvements.

subject: Request for project timeline
body: We are considering a website upgrade. Please explain how you estimate the timeline and what factors affect delivery.

subject: Support hours
body: Could you tell me your support team's working hours and how to contact them outside those hours?

subject: Update contact information
body: I need to change the email address associated with my account. Where can I update this information?

subject: Feature availability
body: Does the platform support adding a video to a page? Please point me to the relevant documentation.

subject: Account access for employee
body: I need to provide a new employee with access to our account. What options are available?

subject: Documentation request
body: Could you share documentation explaining how to manage website pages and update their content?

subject: Data export
body: I need to export our customer information for reporting. Please tell me whether this is supported and where to find the instructions.

subject: Security concern
body: I received an unfamiliar login notification. Please tell me the recommended security steps and whether this needs escalation.

subject: Service availability
body: Is there a confirmed service outage today? Please provide an official status update if one is available.

subject: Data retention policy
body: How long does the platform retain customer data, and where can I find the official policy?

subject: Custom feature request
body: Can you confirm whether you guarantee a 100 percent increase in our revenue after implementing a new feature?

subject: Follow-up on ticket
body: I am following up on my earlier support request. Could you review the ticket and share any available update?

subject: Change billing email
body: Please explain how I can change the email address that receives our billing notifications.

subject: Request for refund exception
body: I missed the refund deadline because of an emergency. Can you guarantee that an exception will be approved?

subject: Domain configuration
body: I connected my domain but the website is not loading from the new address. What should I verify?

subject: Request to delete account
body: I would like to delete my account and associated data. Please explain the official process and any consequences.

subject: Unexpected website change
body: The homepage changed without my approval. Please help me investigate the change and secure administrator access.

subject: Meeting request
body: Could we arrange a meeting to discuss our website redesign requirements and the next steps for a proposal?

subject: Discount eligibility
body: Can you confirm whether our account qualifies for a discount? Please share the official eligibility rules.

subject: Request for data recovery
body: Some of our website content appears to be missing. Is there an official recovery process, and can you help us determine what is recoverable?

subject: Question about a feature
body: Can you explain whether the platform supports a feature that automatically sends reminders to customers, and where I can find the documentation?
